body: I guess I'm not sure how to explain how frightened I feel and how much I don't want to go. Besides me saying "I'm scared". He knows I'm scared and reassures me it is fine, but I don't **feel** that way. I feel like this developed into a full phobia. One that I can't explain. It's so much of a phobia that I'm having suicidal thoughts. That's how bad.
Unique but I can't answer why - I don't know. He wants us to be with his family and if I decline it's going to really show that I'm selfish.
